information_components.definition: Whether candidate text pair is located within a table region on the page
information_components.human_observable: YES — Human can visually identify table structure from PDF page image
information_components.machine_observable: PARTIALLY — table_line_detector.py EXISTS in chunker/ but NOT integrated into P1-P6 pipeline; P6 DENSE_REGION correlates but is NOT table-specific
information_components.pipeline_stage: P1 (skips non-text blocks) / P6 (DENSE/SPARSE only, explicitly bans table labels)
information_components.stability: MEDIUM — table_line_detector has column stability verification (≥75% alignment) and text-ratio check (≥45% text cells); but not tested on independent biology paper tables
information_components.cross_document: PARTIALLY — tested on device manuals (RA101, C216) in chunker context; NOT tested on qbio_rna/qbio_genomics table layouts
information_components.evidence: 3/3 FP cases: Human explicitly cited 'table', 'different columns', 'separate cells' as decision basis
information_components.risk: FALSE TABLE DETECTION — DENSE_REGION may fire on dense body text; table_line_detector may miss borderless tables or non-standard layouts
information_components.status: PARTIALLY_AVAILABLE — detection capability exists but NOT in P1-P6 pipeline

information_components.definition: Bounding box of individual table cells containing text_a and text_b
information_components.human_observable: YES — Human can visually identify cell boundaries from table grid lines or spacing
information_components.machine_observable: NO — P1-P6 does not detect cell boundaries; table_line_detector.py produces cell-level grid but is NOT integrated
information_components.existing_source: chunker/table_line_detector.py (row_cells function produces grid); P1 bbox per observation (not per cell)
information_components.pipeline_stage: N/A in P1-P6; available in chunker pipeline only
information_components.stability: UNKNOWN — not tested on independent evaluation corpus
information_components.evidence: 3/3 FP: Human cited 'separate cells' — cell boundary is the structural unit that distinguishes TOC heading from table data
information_components.risk: CELL BOUNDARY UNAVAILABLE — without cell detection, cannot determine if text_a and text_b are in same or different cells

information_components.definition: Which table row contains text_a and text_b (same row = horizontal neighbors; different row = vertical neighbors)
information_components.human_observable: YES — Human can identify row membership from visual layout
information_components.machine_observable: NO — P1-P6 does not detect rows; dy=0.0 (same y) is available but is NOT row-specific (also true for same-line body text)
information_components.pipeline_stage: P2 (dy available) / chunker (row detection not in P1-P6)
information_components.stability: LOW for row detection — dy=0.0 is necessary but not sufficient for same-row (body text also has dy=0.0)
information_components.evidence: 3/3 FP: all have dy=0.0 (same y), confirming same-row; but dy=0.0 also true for 351 DETERMINISTIC_MERGE pairs — not discriminative alone
information_components.risk: ROW AMBIGUITY — dy=0.0 cannot distinguish table row from body text line
information_components.status: NOT_AVAILABLE — row detection not in P1-P6

information_components.definition: Which table column contains text_a and text_b (same column = vertical; different column = horizontal neighbors)
information_components.human_observable: YES — Human can identify column membership from x-position alignment
information_components.machine_observable: PARTIALLY — bbox x-coordinates available in P2; could be clustered into columns; but P1-P6 does not perform column clustering for table cells
information_components.pipeline_stage: P2 (x-coordinates available) / chunker (column clustering not in P1-P6)
information_components.stability: MEDIUM — x-coordinate clustering is geometrically stable; but requires knowing it's a table first
information_components.cross_document: UNKNOWN — not tested on independent corpus
information_components.evidence: 3/3 FP: bbox_a and bbox_b have significantly different x-coordinates (e.g., IND-AMB-247: bbox_a=[390,280,407,291], bbox_b=[446,280,488,291] — 39pt x-gap); Human cited 'different columns'
information_components.risk: COLUMN AMBIGUITY — without table region detection, x-gap could be intra-cell spacing or inter-column gap
information_components.status: PARTIALLY_AVAILABLE — raw x-coordinates available, column clustering not performed

information_components.definition: Whether text_a and text_b belong to the SAME cell or DIFFERENT cells
information_components.human_observable: YES — Human can visually determine if two text fragments are in the same cell or different cells
information_components.machine_observable: NO — P1-P6 does not detect cells; no cell boundary information available
information_components.evidence: 3/3 FP: Human determined text_a and text_b are in DIFFERENT cells (different columns) — this is the core discriminating information
information_components.risk: CRITICAL — without cell membership, cannot distinguish 'number+title in same cell' (TOC heading) from 'number+text in different cells' (table row)

information_components.definition: Whether text_a or text_b is a table header; what column header applies to each
information_components.human_observable: YES — Human can identify header row and map cells to column headers
information_components.machine_observable: NO — P1-P6 does not detect headers; table_line_detector.py has header absorption but NOT integrated
information_components.existing_source: chunker/table_line_detector.py (head_rows, header extraction); NOT in P1-P6
information_components.stability: LOW — header detection relies on position + text length heuristics; may fail on multi-row headers or merged cells
information_components.evidence: IND-AMB-223: Human identified 'Case study' column vs 'RNA Specimen' column — header relation provides semantic role
information_components.risk: HEADER/BODY CONFUSION — without header detection, cannot determine semantic role of cell content

information_components.definition: Whether text pair is in table body (data cells) vs header vs caption
information_components.evidence: 3/3 FP: all in table body (data cells, not headers)
information_components.risk: MEDIUM — body/header distinction affects semantic interpretation

information_components.definition: Content of adjacent cells in the same row/column (provides context for semantic role)
information_components.human_observable: YES — Human can read surrounding cells to infer column meaning
information_components.machine_observable: NO — P1-P6 does not detect cells or neighbors
information_components.evidence: IND-AMB-247: Human identified '121' as 'molecular weight' / 'RNA length' by reading column context
information_components.risk: HIGH — neighboring cells provide semantic context that may be necessary for correct interpretation

information_components.definition: Whether text_a and text_b align to stable column centers across multiple rows
information_components.human_observable: YES — Human perceives column alignment visually
information_components.machine_observable: PARTIALLY — x-coordinates available; column center clustering possible; but NOT performed in P1-P6
information_components.pipeline_stage: P2 (raw data) / chunker (clustering not in P1-P6)
information_components.stability: MEDIUM — geometric clustering is deterministic; but requires table region detection first
information_components.evidence: 3/3 FP: x-coordinates show clear column separation (bbox_a x0 vs bbox_b x0 differ by 23-56pt)
information_components.risk: REQUIRES TABLE DETECTION FIRST — column alignment is meaningful only within a table context
information_components.status: PARTIALLY_AVAILABLE — raw coordinates available, alignment analysis not performed

summary.existing_but_not_integrated: table_line_detector.py in chunker/ provides table_region + cell_boundary + row + column + header + grid, but is NOT integrated into P1-P6 perception pipeline
summary.p6_table_labels: NONE — P6 explicitly bans table/image/figure/heading labels (geometric only)
summary.key_finding: IS-11 evidence EXISTS in the codebase (table_line_detector.py) but is NOT accessible through P1-P6 pipeline. P6 DENSE_REGION is a weak proxy (correlates with table density but also fires on dense body text). Cell membership — the core discriminating information — is completely unavailable.
